summary: Ran backend-only regression of test_features_v5.py with -n 0. All 18 tests PASS, including the primary contract test_reseed_repairs_corrupt_password_hash which corrupts ana's password_hash in Postgres, restarts backend via supervisorctl, and verifies login returns 200 after seed_users re-hashes. Verified seed.py lines 65-79 contain the idempotent else-branch re-hash for VENDORS_DEMO (ana/bruno/carla). Sanity: all 6 seeded accounts (admin/vendedor/contador/ana/bruno/carla) log in with spec credentials returning access_token + user without password_hash leak. Security: wrong password -> 401 'Credenciais inválidas'. Contador middleware: all 5 mutation endpoints (/orders, /customers, /leads, /goals, /goals/products) return 403 'Contador é somente-leitura' while /auth/login still works.
critical_code_review_comments: seed.py line 74 currently only re-hashes when verify_password fails; comment on line 72 says 'Always re-hash' which is slightly misleading — behavior is correct (conditional re-hash) but comment could be tightened. Non-blocking.
